governing_principle: Commercial speculation is retired and assigned zero expected future revenue. Engineering capacity goes to verified autonomy, reliability, security, maintainability, and explicit user-requested project improvements.

primary_experiment.name: RETIRED — Roblox micro-product factory
primary_experiment.thesis: Historical experiment only. No further product construction, marketplace publication, demand testing, or commercial expansion is authorized by this policy.
primary_experiment.initial_format: Paid models first; plugins only for genuinely tool-shaped functionality.
success_evidence: verified marketplace review or support request demonstrating use
repeat sales without additional paid acquisition
buyer request for an adjacent feature or bundle
primary_experiment.failure_rule: Experiment retired. Preserve historical evidence; allocate no further engineering or commercial-validation work.
primary_experiment.build_rule: Do not build additional SKUs or spend paid-model budget under this retired experiment.
primary_experiment.rights_rule: Commercial SKUs must be original/generic implementations. Brookhaven-specific assets, proprietary UI/art, school-specific content, private data, and unverified third-party code are excluded.

resource_rules: Engineering capacity goes to verified autonomy, reliability, security, maintainability, and explicit user-requested improvements.
Commercial speculation, marketplace-demand research, outreach generation, replacement business ideation, and new revenue experiments receive zero autonomous allocation.
Historical commercial evidence may be observed for record integrity but cannot create new work, investment credit, or owner action requests.
Do not use paid model/API budget for retired commercial experiments.
